notes:
September 11th 2026
Version 13.10+ (stable) / 13.11+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Re-synchronized several data issues. (K,R)
* New audio editor for backing tracks - trim, fade, level and tone (EQ). (K,R)
* Zoom the tree text with Cmd/Ctrl + and - (Cmd/Ctrl 0 resets); every tree in the window follows. (K) (R)
* Live Editor changes now reach your accordion in real-time - the "Send to Accordion" button has been removed. (R)
* Write/Save shows a * while the accordion is playing changes you have not saved yet. (R)
* Live Editor: an Undo button takes back your last change - the accordion follows. (R)
* Chin switches, Master Bar and Effect Pot now take effect as you set them. (R)
* Press Ctrl+R any time to ask a question or report an issue. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
notes_beta:
September 18th 2026 (evening)
Version 13.11.31+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Global Settings: Send and Write/Save no longer overwrite settings changed on the accordion's panel. (R)
* Write/Save skips the flash commit when nothing changed, so the FR-4X pause only happens when needed. (R)
* Windows updates: the installer now opens in front of other windows. (K,R)
* Orchestra Tone List: readable in the light theme. (R)
* Light theme: About, release notes, Getting Started, update notes and activation windows corrected. (K,R)
* Fix Files That Won't Play: the log now names each junk file removed. (K,R)
* Silent orchestra register, second cause: effect settings that belong to another effect (from an FR-4X) are switched off on import, reset when an FR-8X file opens, and reported by the Integrity Check. (R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
